paper_title: One Tokenizer To Rule Them All Emergent Language Plasticity via   Multilingual Tokenizers
caption: : Effect of vocabulary size.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the comparison of accuracy percentages across different tokenizers over a range of data points. The x-axis represents "Token" with a linear scale, spanning from 100k to 250k, with tick marks at 100k, 175k, and 250k. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", also using a linear scale, ranging from 40.0 to 42.0, with ticks at 0.5 intervals. The plot contains two lines representing different tokenizers. The first line is blue with star markers and a solid style, labeled "universal." It starts at an accuracy of 40.5 at 100k tokens and increases steadily to reach 41.2 at 175k, then further rises to 41.8 at 250k. The second line is orange with circular markers and a solid style, labeled "cluster." It begins at approximately 41.6 at 100k tokens, slightly rises to about 41.7 at 175k, and then decreases to approximately 41.4 at 250k tokens. A legend is placed at the bottom right corner representing different tokenizer and its corresponding colors.
